cohort: 855 women with dichorionic diamniotic twin gestations
finding: Patients who underwent elective twin pregnancy reduction had a higher gestational age of delivery and lower rates of preterm birth and pregnancy complications, without an increased risk of pregnancy loss, compared to those with ongoing twin pregnancies.
mod_finding: Women with twin pregnancies who underwent elective twin pregnancy reduction had a lower risk of preterm birth and pregnancy complications, including cesarean delivery, compared to those who continued with their twin pregnancy.
